title: Approachable · adj.
subtitle: 「平易近人／容易交談／友善／容易接觸」，究竟是哪一種 approachable？
description: 「平易近人／容易交談／友善／容易接觸」，究竟是哪一種 approachable？

words.meaning: 容易交談的；容易親近的；讓人敢開口的
words.note: 使用者提供。當 approachable 形容一個人讓別人感到可以自然開口、提問、聊天或尋求幫助時，easy to talk to 是非常直接、自然的改寫。它比 friendly 更強調溝通上的心理門檻低。
words.example: The new manager is easy to talk to.

exercises.original: The lecturer is very approachable, so students often stay behind to ask questions.
exercises.zh: 這位講師很容易交談，所以學生常在課後留下來提問。
exercises.upgrade: easy to talk to · 容易交談的；容易親近的；讓人敢開口的

options.explanation: stay behind to ask questions 表明學生覺得開口沒有壓力，最適合 easy to talk to。
強調友善、親切和令人感到受歡迎。 但本題的決定性線索是 students feel comfortable asking questions；這句真正要表達的是「容易讓人開口交流」。因此 friendly 雖與 approachable 有重疊，社交功能、可接觸性、情感溫度或性格重點並不最吻合。
強調容易接觸、聯絡或取得協助。 但本題的決定性線索是 students feel comfortable asking questions；這句真正要表達的是「容易讓人開口交流」。因此 accessible 雖與 approachable 有重疊，社交功能、可接觸性、情感溫度或性格重點並不最吻合。

強調整體社交舉止討人喜歡、自然親切。 但本題的決定性線索是 students feel comfortable asking questions；這句真正要表達的是「容易讓人開口交流」。因此 personable 雖與 approachable 有重疊，社交功能、可接觸性、情感溫度或性格重點並不最吻合。
強調願意接受問題、意見、回饋和不同觀點。 但本題的決定性線索是 students feel comfortable asking questions；這句真正要表達的是「容易讓人開口交流」。因此 open 雖與 approachable 有重疊，社交功能、可接觸性、情感溫度或性格重點並不最吻合。

words.note: 使用者提供。friendly 強調態度友善、熱情或令人感到受歡迎。它與 approachable 高度重疊，但一個人可以 friendly 卻未必讓人容易提出困難問題；因此兩者不是完全相同。
words.example: The receptionist was friendly and welcoming.

falseSynonyms.zh: easy to talk to 專注於容易開口交流；approachable 還可以包含容易接近、聯絡或不令人畏縮。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The counsellor is easy to talk to. The manager is approachable.

falseSynonyms.zh: friendly 強調友善；一個人可以 friendly，但在權力、時間或制度上仍不容易 approach。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The receptionist was friendly. The director is approachable to junior staff.

falseSynonyms.zh: accessible 更偏『容易聯絡／取得』；approachable 更偏人際感受與心理門檻。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The adviser is accessible by phone. The adviser is approachable in person.

falseSynonyms.zh: welcoming 強調讓人感到被接納；approachable 更強調容易靠近、開口。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The office has a welcoming atmosphere. The teacher is approachable.

falseSynonyms.zh: personable 是整體社交魅力與討人喜歡；approachable 不一定意味很有魅力，只需不令人畏縮。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The presenter was personable. The supervisor was approachable.

falseSynonyms.zh: open 強調接受意見、問題與回饋；approachable 強調別人願意主動走近或開口。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is open to criticism. She is approachable when staff need help.

falseSynonyms.zh: easygoing 是隨和性格；approachable 可以是正式、嚴謹但仍願意聆聽的人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is easygoing about small mistakes. The judge was formal but approachable.

falseSynonyms.zh: available 只表示有空或可取得，不保證態度友善或不令人緊張。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The doctor is available this afternoon. The doctor is approachable and patient.
